text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle crossed the finish line in 1st 
place at the Centaur Stakes. However, 
afterwards, she crouched down in the 
underground paddock tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Helping her up, the Trainer felt how light 
she was—a sobering reminder of what it 
truly means to run with everything on the 
line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The miracle that allows him to run will 
only last until the Sprinters Stakes— 
Seeing K.S.Miracle's desperation, the 
Trainer was about to deliver an answer 
that felt almost like a betrayal.
